# MovPrompt

> AI Director of Photography. Turn any still image into a director-grade cinematic video prompt for Veo, Kling, Runway, Seedance, Sora, Hailuo, Wan, and Pika.

MovPrompt analyzes a frame, breaks it into subject, background, lighting, and atmosphere, then writes a model-tuned prompt with camera direction, negative prompt, and a recommended model.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Drop a frame, pick a model, get a cinematic video prompt.
- [Sign in](/auth): Sign in or create a MovPrompt account.
- [Learn](/learn): Practical guide to writing director-grade AI video prompts.
- [Privacy](/privacy): How MovPrompt collects and protects data.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.
